title: 第一章 年轻将军
content_zh:
元和十一年，唐宪宗李纯，在位期间昏庸无能，党乱之争，征伐不断草菅人命，民不聊生。自从藩镇割据以后农民起义接连不断。

    此时一群白衣男子骑着马映入眼帘，一席白衣不染尘土甚是高雅，为首的虽是青年但一眼望去就气度不凡。

    再一看他们脸上的神色，虽然他们神态气势各有不同，但他们脸上多挂着几分紧张，惊恐，只是为首的那个青年人在他那张英俊的脸上却是波澜不惊。

    原来他们后面还有一群人马，此人个个都穿着黑袍，一脸杀气。

    那群白衣男子已经有几百人了，远处一看甚是壮观。但是在他们身后的那群黑衣人们那就更是可怕了，密密麻麻足有数万人之多。

    就连傻子都能看出那群黑衣人正在追击白衣男子们，那后果更是不用想了，如果被抓到了那一定就如沙土进入江河之中一去不复回。

    “李磊!还不速速束手就擒，牛大人说了如果投降给你加官进爵，不然就是死路一条!”忽然，那群黑衣人为首的男子说话了。原来那白衣青年人叫李磊。

    李磊，从小出身于贫困农民家庭，本来生活并不富裕，但是连年饥荒，征战不断更是导致他家破人亡，成为一个小叫花子到处乞讨，好在他五岁时遇见了他的贵人赵毅佑。

    赵毅佑乃是一名武官，出身和李磊一样也是农民自幼勤学苦练，雄心壮志，可谓是一表人才。见小时候的李磊便好心收留培养，教他琴棋书画，诗酒花茶，武刀弄剑，修仙炼丹什么都教把李磊当亲儿子一样对待。李磊虽然生性调皮，但也是非常聪明伶俐的人，更是对修仙练武有着很强的天赋。

    十二岁就已经和赵毅佑的起义军一起上战杀敌了。

    将军百战死，一转八年，虽然赵毅佑已经战死沙场但李磊经历大大小小无数战役已经成为起义军定永军的领袖，虽然年纪轻轻但是他已经是一个心动圆满的强者了。

    修仙境界分为:筑基期，开光期，融合期，心动期，结丹期，元婴期，出窍期，分身期，合体期，洞虚期，大乘期，然后就可以渡劫成仙了。每一个阶段又分为:初期，中期，后期，圆满。

    到达心动期肉体已经不是一般强横了；而到到达了结丹期就能够御剑飞行了；到达了元婴期就拥有凡人所无法拥有的寿命；到达出窍期就能元神出窍神游天外；而到了分神期，能利自己神识分成多份同时运用；合体期就是元婴和肉身合一，达到完全合一的时候，身体能够支持瞬移了，就意味着要进入下一个境界--大乘了。

    修至大乘肉身不灭，神体待开，巩固修为，累积力量，准备渡劫；渡劫成功就可以升为仙，这正是李磊梦寐以求的事情了。而现在李磊虽然只是心动圆满但在这里已经是非常厉害了，以他的能力不出百岁一定能飞升成仙。
content_en:
In the eleventh year of Yuanhe, Li Chun, Emperor Xianzong of the Tang Dynasty, was incompetent during his reign. The party was in chaos, and conquests continued to kill people. The people were in dire straits. Since the secession of feudal towns, peasant uprisings have continued one after another.

    At this time, a group of men in white clothes came into view riding on horses. Their white clothes were not stained by dust and were very elegant. Although the leader was a young man, he seemed to have an extraordinary bearing at first glance.

    Looking at the expressions on their faces again, although their expressions and auras were different, their faces were more nervous and frightened, but the young man in the lead had a calm expression on his handsome face.

    It turned out that there was a group of people behind them. They were all wearing black robes and had murderous looks on their faces.

    The group of men in white already numbered several hundred, and it was quite spectacular from a distance. But the group of people in black behind them was even more terrifying, densely packed with tens of thousands of people.

    Even a fool can see that the group of men in black are chasing the men in white. There is no need to think about the consequences. If they are caught, they will be like sand entering a river and never return.

    "Li Lei! Why don't you surrender quickly? Master Niu said that if you surrender, you will be promoted to a higher rank, otherwise you will be dead!" Suddenly, the group of men headed by men in black spoke. It turns out that the young man in white is called Li Lei.

    Li Lei was born in a poor peasant family and his life was not rich originally. However, years of famine and continuous wars led to the destruction of his family and he became a little beggar everywhere. Fortunately, when he was five years old, he met his nobleman Zhao Yiyou.

    Zhao Yiyou is a military attache. Like Li Lei, he was also a farmer. He studied hard and practiced hard since he was a child. He is ambitious and can be said to be a top-notch talent. When he saw Li Lei as a child, he kindly took him in and trained him. He taught him music, chess, calligraphy and painting, poetry, wine and tea, swordsmanship, immortality and alchemy. He treated Li Lei like his own son. Although Li Lei is naughty by nature, he is also a very smart person and has a strong talent for cultivating immortals and practicing martial arts.

    At the age of twelve, he had already gone to battle with Zhao Yiyou's rebel army to kill the enemy.

    The general died in hundreds of battles, and eight years later, although Zhao Yiyou had died on the battlefield, Li Lei had gone through countless battles, large and small, and had become the leader of the rebel army Dingyong Army. Although he was young, he was already a strong man with a heartbeat.

    The realm of cultivating immortals is divided into: foundation building stage, consecration stage, fusion stage, heartbeat stage, elixir formation stage, Nascent Soul stage, out-of-body stage, clone stage, integration stage, hole void stage, Mahayana stage, and then you can overcome the tribulation and become an immortal. Each stage is divided into: early stage, middle stage, late stage and completion.

    When you reach the heartbeat stage, your body is no longer powerful; when you reach the elixir stage, you can fly with a sword; when you reach the Nascent Soul stage, you have a lifespan that ordinary people cannot have; when you reach the Out-of-Body Stage, your soul can leave your body and wander around the world; when you reach the Distraction Stage, you can divide your consciousness into multiple parts and use it at the same time; in the Integration Stage, the Yuanying and the physical body are integrated into one. When complete unity is reached, the body can support teleportation, which means entering the next realm - the Mahayana.

    After cultivating to the Mahayana, the physical body will be immortal, and the divine body will be opened. Consolidate your cultivation, accumulate strength, and prepare to overcome the tribulation. If you successfully overcome the tribulation, you can be promoted to an immortal. This is what Li Lei has dreamed of. And now, although Li Lei only has a perfect heart, he is already very powerful here. With his ability, he will definitely be able to ascend to immortality before he is a hundred years old.
